claims: The Hand is a mystical ninja clan from Marvel Comics.
The Hand has historically been led by villains like Kingpin and Gorgon.
The Hand has frequently clashed with Daredevil.
Brand New Day shows red-clad ninjas fighting Spider-Man.
Brand New Day is seen on the Threads platform.
The Nerdist article notes that The Hand is known as a sinister supernatural organization often involved in New York City's criminal underworld.
Brand New Day is the MCU’s fourth Spider-Man film.
Brand New Day is set four years after No Way Home.
Brand New Day features appearances by the Punisher.
The Menkind product page notes that the "3D Hand Wall Mounted Deco Light" is a product inspired by Spider-Man.
The "3D Hand Wall Mounted Deco Light" is unrelated to the Hand organization.
